explanation: This South American frog is named for its paradox: the tadpole grows several times longer than the adult it becomes, then shrinks as it turns into a frog.

claims.text: Paradoxical frog tadpoles can grow to about 22 cm long.
Adult paradoxical frogs grow to about 7.5 cm long at most.
The paradoxical frog is named for the contrast between its giant tadpole and its much smaller adult.
Paradoxical frogs live in South America.
The paradoxical frog's tadpole shrinks as it changes into a frog.
